observation: Read-only DOM and media-query snapshots, resize/change listeners, MutationObserver. All quick-read and tools actions use trusted CDP Input. No application methods or DOM click().

toolsInput: Quick-read CSS makes tools mouse-inaccessible. Trusted Shift+Tab and Enter are used to test whether the same hidden control remains keyboard-reachable; no focus() or DOM click() is called.
